Hello!


These advanced electronic systems are powered by:
,56,700 copper ore/min
,32,400 iron ore
,APPROX. 200,000 liquid gas/min 
,APPROX. 28,000 coal. 

All the components necessary to manufacture advanced electronic circuits are produced during this process. It only requires a supply of the four elements listed above. 

 At this moment, the material is being fed into this conveyor from the right side. 


Everything is labeled. 

Everything should be balanced. That's why production should run smoothly as long as you have enough materials to keep it going.  

If there are any issues, please report them in the comments.
